abstract:
Affordance-Guided View Planning for Efficient Task-Oriented Grasping

# GCNGrasp-VP: Affordance-Guided View Planning for Efficient Task-Oriented Grasping [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19091) [ ](https://huggingface.co/TongZJ/GCNGrasp-v2) [ ](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1ewjw6qEbY) 🎉 **Congratulations! This paper has been accepted by IROS 2026!** > Task-oriented grasping performance degrades significantly when object views suffer from occlusions. Existing task-oriented grasping methods typically assume task-relevant regions are visible in the initial frame, while view planning approaches enable active perception but often ignore task semantics and rely on time-consuming scene reconstruction. To address these limitations, we present GCNGrasp-VP, an efficient framework integrating affordance field prediction with active view planning. Central to this framework is GCNGrasp-v2, a task-oriented grasp model that simultaneously supports grasp evaluation and affordance field prediction, achieving constant-time inference complexity. Leveraging this capability, our Affordance-guided View Planner (Affordance-VP) utilizes the affordance field as an information gain metric to guide camera observation of task-relevant regions without requiring scene reconstruction. View planning results show that our method significantly outperforms scene-uncertainty-driven baselines with only one view adjustment. Real-world validation further confirms substantial improvements in grasp success rates for single-object scenarios while maintaining millisecond-level computational latency. ## 🔧 Environment Setup **Parameters:** - `--train`: Model version (`1`, `2`, `2aff`, `gpt`) - `--fold`: Data fold (`o0`, `o1`, `t0`, `t1`) - `--resume`/`--test`: Checkpoint path --- ### 🎮 Demo (`demo.py`) Modify the function call at the bottom of the file: > **Note:** The best model has been uploaded to HuggingFace ([TongZJ/GCNGrasp-v2](https://huggingface.co/TongZJ/GCNGrasp-v2)). abstract_zh: 当物体视图受到遮挡时，任务导向抓取的性能会显著下降。现有的任务导向抓取方法通常假设任务相关区域在初始帧中可见，而视角规划方法虽然能够实现主动感知，但往往忽略任务语义，且依赖耗时的场景重建。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了 GCNGrasp-VP，一个将 affordance 场预测与主动视角规划相结合的高效框架。该框架的核心是 GCNGrasp-v2，一个同时支持抓取评估和 affordance 场预测的任务导向抓取模型，具有常数时间的推理复杂度。利用这一能力，我们的 affordance 引导视角规划器（Affordance-VP）将 affordance 场作为信息增益度量，引导相机观测任务相关区域，而无需场景重建。视角规划结果表明，我们的方法仅需一次视角调整即可显著优于场景不确定性驱动的基线方法。真实世界验证进一步证实，在单物体场景中抓取成功率大幅提升，同时保持毫秒级计算延迟。
tldr_zh: GCNGrasp-VP 用 affordance 场引导视角规划，无需重建即可提升抓取成功率。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 GCNGrasp-VP 框架，将 affordance（可供性）场预测与主动视角规划结合：核心模型 GCNGrasp-v2 同时支持抓取评估与 affordance 场预测且推理复杂度恒定，其预测的 affordance 场被直接用作信息增益度量，由 Affordance-VP 规划器引导相机观察任务相关区域，无需任何场景重建。


# 一、动机

> 面向任务的抓取（task-oriented grasping）方法通常假设初始视角下与任务相关的区域可见，一旦物体被遮挡性能便显著下降；而现有主动视角规划方法虽能主动感知，却忽视任务语义，且依赖耗时的场景重建。


# 二、方法

> 提出 GCNGrasp-VP 框架，将 affordance（可供性）场预测与主动视角规划结合：核心模型 GCNGrasp-v2 同时支持抓取评估与 affordance 场预测且推理复杂度恒定，其预测的 affordance 场被直接用作信息增益度量，由 Affordance-VP 规划器引导相机观察任务相关区域，无需任何场景重建。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在视角规划实验中，该方法仅需一次视角调整即显著优于以场景不确定性为驱动的基线；真实世界验证表明单物体场景下抓取成功率获得明显提升，同时保持毫秒级计算延迟。论文已被 IROS 2026 接收，模型权重已开源于 HuggingFace（TongZJ/GCNGrasp-v2）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 优势在于把任务语义（affordance）直接作为主动感知的探索信号，规避了重建带来的时间开销，适合实时机器人抓取；局限是真实世界验证主要覆盖单物体场景，多物体堆叠与遮挡复杂场景的泛化性、以及 affordance 场预测误差对视角决策的影响仍需进一步考察。
